title: Chapter 903
paragraphs: Chapter 903
Episode 227. A new enemy, enemies of enemies (4)
On the bridge of Zifl's second flagship, Cojek2.
Originally, the commander of Cojek2 was Octavia, but now the fleet was being led by three special bio-golems.
Betty, Almatia, and Kuhn. They were commanding the fleet on behalf o
f Beradin, Octavia, and Satrien, respectively.
There were hardly any human magicians on Cojek2.
The majority of the crew were bio-golems of the mage warrior corps, known as 'mareyeongdae'.
The same went for all the ships that stretched out endlessly behind the leading flagship.
Regular magicians only made up about 20% of the total force.
"Do you really think the Bamel Union will follow us, as the head said?"
"I'm curious too. The head decided to put this power into motion without the help of the Demon God Stone. What did he say again, that Jin Runcandel would definitely understand his intention?"
At Almatia and Kuhn's words, Betty shook her head.
"Don't doubt the head's judgment. And the future calculation of the Demon God Stone is still incomplete, so it might be better not to apply it to such important matters."
Betty, she was the leader of the mareyeongdae.
The two vice commanders nodded, watching Betty's mood.
"Ahem, I was just saying."
"Well, whatever orders the head gives, we follow. And if the situation seems to get worse because of his order, it's our job to somehow make it better."
Human, the three special bio-golems including Kuhn perceived themselves that way.
They considered themselves not merely bio-golems but humans.
In fact, they had elements that could be called ego and personality, and no one in Zifl treated them lightly.
Rather, they were feared. The mareyeongdae was Zifl's strongest unit directly under the head, following the ghost corps and phantom unit, and it was natural for the three of them to be their leaders.
Even more so, the three were receiving honors on par with the highest-ranked pureblood Zifl because they held the castle of Zifl.
The ghost corps usually handled special operations, and since its establishment, the phantom unit was infamous as an execution unit.
The mareyeongdae could be considered a unit specialized in conducting large-scale warfare.

This was because the mareyeongdae was generally composed of members with exceptionally high combat abilities, and even if many of them died in battle, it would not cause significant political problems.
"Except for Betty, Almatia, and Koon, the rest of the troops were merely bio-golems, referred to by 'identification numbers.'

If a bio-golem dies, no, if it is destroyed, it could simply be produced again. Of course, resources would be consumed, but it was a small price to pay compared to the death of a trained human magician.
Even if the average combat power is outstanding, aside from Betty, Almatia, and Koon, the rest are merely bio-golems.
They cannot have higher value than real 8th and 9th level magicians.
"Number 374."
"Yes, Captain."
"Increase the speed, we should be able to attack Grosh's defensive line before midnight."
"Understood."
Currently, the Zifel fleet advancing towards Grosh Castle is exactly one thousand. Moreover, Zifel planned to continuously support the frontline with additional fleets every two days.

While Zifel did not possess advanced technologies like spatial leap and long-range communication like the Barmel Alliance, their possession of war materials and the production power based on them were overwhelming other forces.
Thanks to obtaining the method to use 'sanctuaries' through the ability of the Sun God's Priestess, Sanna.
And Beradin was slowly planning to deal with her. This was due to one piece of information the Magic Stone had recently told Beradin.
"Rebel Kellick Zifel… I didn't expect him to recover and take his place in hell."
"And yet the priestess, knowing this fact, did not inform the lord, Betty. As expected, those Sun God believers have no intention of truly serving the lord."

"The lord anticipated this from the beginning. He knew a day would come when we would have to split from the Sun God's believers. We still have more to gain from the sanctuary, so we have to keep her alive for now, but we must deal with her before she inflates the situation."

"One of the worst cases in the futures calculated by the Magic Stone is the priestess and Kellick joining hands. Ah, it would be nice if we could capture the Contractor of Az Mil that the Barmel Alliance holds. If the Magic Stone's future calculations were perfect, there would be no need to worry."

"Since Jin Runkandel formed an alliance with Tikhan, the Contractor of Az Mil has never been exposed to danger. Capturing Yuria Alfrion will only be possible after the Barmel Alliance starts to collapse. Because the hunting of the gods has been delayed due to continuous wars, we must thoroughly clear the demon world first with this invasion."
"Don't worry, our captain. Koon and I will just massacre the devil guys from tonight."

"I was bored dealing only with the remnants of the enemy tribes. They were obviously weakening, but since we couldn't find their home base, we couldn't end them. But it's less frustrating because Grosh Castle, the main base of the demon world, is openly on the sea."

"In Grosh Castle, there's surely some kind of passageway leading to the real Demon World. From there, we can strike at the heart of the Demon World. After seizing Grosh Castle, we'll avoid any conflict with the Barmel Alliance or Kinselo until we penetrate the Demon World and assess the situation. Everyone got that? Even if you encounter the powerhouses of the alliance at the front, don't get excited and rush in."

"Yes, yes, we understand. It's a bit disappointing, but it can't be helped. The important thing is not our personal pride, but the mission. We can always compete with the superhumans of the Barmel Alliance after we've finished off the Demon World."

"It's not just 'whenever', it's a necessity to kill them. Our ultimate enemies are not the Demon World or the enemy tribes, but the Barmel Alliance and Runcandel. If we don't win against them, everything we've done will be meaningless."
Zieff's fleet continued its relentless journey across the sea of swords and magic.
The thousand-strong fleet cast a massive shadow over the sea, and midnight was fast approaching.
Finally, Betty confirmed the sight of the Demon World's defenses far beyond the ship's bridge.
They had already dealt with several reconnaissance and demon patrols even before they reached here, so the Demon World had allocated more troops to Zieff's side of the defenses.

"Finally, it's the vanguard... It seems they've removed some of the forces guarding the Hupester wall and deployed them here. If it's not a ruse, it means the Demon World's forces are not truly infinite."
As Betty spoke, a small ship flew in from the rear ranks.
It was a small ship launched to bring reports from the rear ranks to Betty.
The pilot of the small ship entered the interior of the Kozak2 and found the bridge.
"What is it, Number 1704?"
"About three hours ago, we received intelligence that the Barmel Alliance's barrier started moving. Also, many new superhumans are being added to the front line of the barrier, Captain."
At that, Betty grinned.
"As expected, the Master's prediction was accurate. Immediately relay this news to all the captains. We won't have to return to our clan in vain."
"Understood."
"All units prepare for battle. Number 374, change to breakthrough formation for up to Fleet 5."
"Yes."
Boom…!
A huge signal flare burst into the sky. The flare formed a cryptogram in the sky, similar to a seal of fire.

"All fleets scatter and prepare for bombardment, then handle the scattered and pushed back enemies. Almatia, Kun, you two will command the battles at the 6th and 7th fleets which will be the axes of the encirclement."
"Eh? You're going to break through with a solo fleet? Isn't it easier for us to go in together?"

"In the midst of being tormented by demons escaping to Grosh Castle through suddenly appearing spatial rifts, summoning, and spatial leap magic, this is the first time we're striking at the enemy's stronghold."
"So, are you saying we need to let our enemies know that there are many strong entities like monsters in Zipfel?"

"Yes. And they haven't grasped the situation yet. So, they've only been able to pull this many troops from the wall. We should also warn them that they can't possibly defend both fronts, our forces and the coalition's wall."
Betty left the bridge and took her position at the head of the Cojack2. The defense line of the demon world began to bombard with various magics, and the fleet of Zipfel spread the protective shield.
Shrrrr...!
Betty glared at the enemies, holding her staff and sword.
Whrrrr...!
A destruction flame spell formed on the staff, and the sword was wrapped with the magic power of light and aura.
"Let's kill them all, from now on. This is Betty Zipfel."
At the same time, in the Kinselo Headquarters.
Kinselo also confirmed the news that the forces of Rune Kandel and Zipfel were advancing towards Groche Castle.
[Hoo… Unexpected. I thought that Rune Kandel would obviously start to attack Groche Castle and pull in other large forces. I didn’t expect Beradin Zipfel to make such a decision.]
“That's right, Master. As you said, since the Royal Family has the leash of the enemy tribe, it seems they have not fully recovered from the damage they suffered from fighting with Zipfel.”

[The Royal Family, those Melka bastards, probably wouldn't have deliberately supplied blood and information to the enemy tribe. When the enemy tribe hesitates like now, and so Zipfel, who got a break, starts to advance towards Groche Castle, they will probably give power to the enemy tribe again to pressurize inside the federation. But somehow, I think Beradin probably has prepared for that to some extent.]
“Then what should we do? Like the total attack in the early stage of the Demon War, do we need to join them?”
[Of course, we should. It's hard for us to deal with Zito alone, so this is an opportunity. Order the troops stationed at the wall to advance immediately with the Barmel Union.]

"Hmm, I'm a bit worried. At that time, we were hit by both Zipfel and us trying to match with Jin, I hope it won't happen this time. Well, this time it's not Jin, but Beradin who started it, so I feel like it'll be okay. There weren't many times when we got hit in the back of the head while trying to figure out Beradin's intentions."
Jephyrin shrugged his shoulders.
[Jo.]
"Yes, boss!"
[The fleet of Zipfel will probably be mostly composed of living golems. We will also send additional fleets composed of completed artisans.]
Artisan.
Not long ago, when they met the mines in the underground city of Pireol, Orgal secretly took some of their fragments without Manoff knowing.
And Jo analyzed the information of those fragments and finally completed the development of the artisan.
"Ooh, finally it's time for my works to shine! I got it, boss. I'll prepare immediately!"
